description: Books a 30-minute intro video call (Google Meet) with Huntay AzerTürk at a slot returned by get_availability, using the attendee's name and email; Cal.com emails the calendar invitation. Call only after the user has confirmed the slot and their details.

email.description: Attendee's email address; the invitation is sent here.

notes.description: Optional topic of the call (company, project, goals).

start.description: Slot start from get_availability: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" in timeZone (ISO 8601 with offset also accepted).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of start and of the attendee. Defaults to Europe/Istanbul.

name: book_intro_call
title: Book intro call
